Maya (docs): FYI opened #PR-9812 — updating SDK auth example and migration notes. Need quick cross-team check, cc @Aisha @Liam @Evan
Docs CI: Preview build failed for PR-9812: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-9812 — 1 error, 2 warnings :warning:
Sam P: error details? :eyes:
Docs CI: Build log: 
```
Error: docs/reference/sdk/auth.md: line 42: found potential secret sample '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'
```
Maya (docs): Ugh — looks like an accidentally-included private-key sample in the old snippet. I copied it from an internal example.
Aisha (legal): Definitely needs redaction before merge. We can't ship private keys or real customer identifiers.
Liam (security): Also seeing a KMS ARN in the same snippet (aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01). That has to be replaced with a placeholder.
Evan (eng): I can update the SDK sample to use the placeholder and a short note about env var config. Which placeholder do you want?
Aisha (legal): Replace keys/IDs with `<REDACTED_KEY_ID>` and add a brief note: "Do not paste real credentials into docs. Use placeholders or show env var usage." After that legal is good to approve.
Maya (docs): Proposed change (current snippet):
```
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIEvQIBADANBgkq...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----',
  kmsKey: 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01'
});
```
Maya (docs): Suggested redacted snippet (will push in a fixup commit):
```
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, // set this in your env, do not paste real keys
  kmsKey: '<REDACTED_KEY_ID>'
});
```
Sam P: LGTM for content, but CI will need to re-run. Can we also add a sentence in the migration guide explaining how to rotate keys? ops teams will ask.
Evan (eng): I'll add one line about rotation and link to our KMS how-to. Will push changes to PR-9812 in a minute.
Docs CI: Triggered rerun for PR-9812 by @Evan. Status: running...
Docs CI: Preview build success — https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-9812 :white_check_mark: (no secrets detected)
Maya (docs): Thanks everyone. @Aisha @Liam please mark approvals if green from your side — we want to merge before the minor release cutoff (tomorrow 17:00 PT).
Aisha (legal): Approved after redaction. Please ensure commit message references the legal redaction ticket. :white_check_mark:
Liam (security): Quick note — update the wording in the security section to avoid implying KMS key sharing. Approve after that tiny wording tweak. :+1:
Maya (docs): Updated wording pushed. Thanks @Liam. Anything else?
Evan (eng): No blockers from infra side. CI green.
Sam P: I'm happy for a squash-and-merge once the approvals are on the PR. Can one of you add the final review label?
Maya (docs): Added `docs/final-review` label. Merging after release cutoff? We need it in the release, so I'll merge now if approvals present.
Docs CI: Merge scheduled: manual. Please run `make docs-release` after merge if you're including updated HTML assets.
Maya (docs): Merged PR-9812 — squashed commits, added release note entry. :shipit:
Sam P: Thanks folks. Nice quick turnaround.
Aisha (legal): Confirmed release note sanitized. All good.
Liam (security): Checked prod preview, looks clean. :thumbsup:
Maya (docs): Closing thread — filed follow-up to audit real-examples sweep (#DOCS-224).
